messages.subject: Responsible growth, stakeholder execution and energy transition | Executive value proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Eikeseth,

Your appointment as President and CEO comes as Aker Solutions advances a broader energy-services portfolio, digital transformation and disciplined project execution across mature and emerging markets. That combination is why I am reaching out directly.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional execution in a capital-intensive operating environment. I work where external expectations, operational priorities and reputation-sensitive decisions need to become accountable action.

I prepared the attached executive value brief around areas where this background may support Aker Solutions: responsible growth in regulated markets, government and stakeholder alignment, sustainability governance, energy-transition execution and stronger links between external commitments and operating delivery. The final three pages contain my executive CV.

I would value a short discussion on whether this profile fits a current or emerging Director, Head, country-facing or strategic mandate within Aker Solutions. I am based in Guyana, open to international relocation, and would require employer-supported Norwegian work authorization.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group

+592 608 4735

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal for Aker Solutions
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Aker Solutions is entering a new leadership phase while advancing energy services, project execution, digitalisation and lower-carbon solutions across international markets. My proposition is to strengthen the institutional and stakeholder side of that execution. I lead government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive coordination for a major mining operation within Zijin Mining Group. I bring a practical record of aligning regulators, public institutions, operating teams and senior management around complex commitments, approvals and reputation-sensitive priorities. This combination is relevant where growth, transformation and energy-transition projects depend on disciplined external engagement and internal accountability.
strategic_brief.company_context: Aker Solutions has built a strong project portfolio while extending its position across traditional energy services and transition-related markets. The company's current direction includes offshore wind, carbon capture and removal, hydropower, digital and AI-enabled performance, and life-cycle services across multiple geographies. Paal Eikeseth's background in performance improvement, transformation and profitable growth signals continued emphasis on execution quality and competitiveness. Recent collaboration with Microsoft on carbon capture also highlights the need to combine engineering, data, governments, industry stakeholders and investment readiness. These priorities create demand for leaders who connect external institutions, sustainability expectations and complex operating delivery without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

opportunities.title: Government and stakeholder execution for growth markets
opportunities.rationale: International energy and infrastructure projects face permitting, policy, public-sector, community and reputation dependencies that sit outside the engineering workstream but still affect schedule, investment readiness and operating continuity. Strong country-facing execution reduces friction around these dependencies.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I lead relationships across ministries, regulators, public institutions and strategic stakeholders while coordinating internal technical and corporate teams. I would bring a structured approach to stakeholder mapping, executive escalation, institutional engagement and documented follow-through for priority markets and projects.

opportunities.title: Responsible transition from commitments to delivery
opportunities.rationale: Carbon capture, renewable power and other transition projects increasingly require credible sustainability narratives backed by measurable governance, data and stakeholder accountability. The commercial value comes when these commitments support bankability, customer confidence, approvals and long-term delivery rather than stand alone as reporting exercises.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: My role combines ESG governance with operating execution, including renewable-energy stakeholder alignment and carbon-data traceability. I would connect sustainability expectations to owners, milestones, evidence and management decisions across business development and project-delivery interfaces.

opportunities.title: Cross-functional governance in high-scrutiny environments
opportunities.rationale: Large projects often require legal, HSE, environment, procurement, finance, operations, communications and leadership teams to respond together. Fragmented ownership increases delays, inconsistent messages and weak evidence trails when regulators or strategic partners need clear answers.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I routinely coordinate these functions around inspections, official visits, approvals, corrective actions and external commitments. I would apply the same operating discipline to high-priority Aker Solutions issues, creating clear owners, deadlines, evidence requirements and executive visibility.

opportunities.title: International stakeholder intelligence for transformation
opportunities.rationale: Transformation programmes gain strength when customer, regulator, government and workforce perspectives are integrated early. Aker Solutions' digital and performance agenda creates opportunities to pair internal efficiency improvements with sharper external intelligence and market-specific institutional context.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: My career spans mining, regulated banking and commercial account leadership, with executive development across China and the UAE. I bring a cross-sector perspective on institutional trust, change communication, stakeholder risk and the translation of strategy into practical country-facing execution.

days_0_30: Map priority external stakeholders, institutional dependencies and governance gaps for the assigned portfolio or geography.
Review strategic projects where approvals, public-sector relationships, ESG commitments or reputation affect execution.
Establish an executive issue register linking external risks to accountable internal owners.
days_31_60: Build targeted stakeholder and government engagement plans for the highest-value projects or markets.
Create concise decision briefs linking external expectations with commercial, operational and sustainability implications.
Strengthen cross-functional routines for evidence, commitments, escalation and executive reporting.
days_61_90: Lead selected priority engagements and close high-value stakeholder or regulatory actions.
Connect sustainability and transition commitments with project governance and measurable operating evidence.
Introduce repeatable templates for country-facing risk, stakeholder intelligence and action tracking.
days_91_180: Scale the strongest practices across additional markets, projects or business units where institutional complexity is material.
Measure issue-resolution speed, stakeholder readiness, evidence quality and executive decision support.
Support leadership on emerging market, responsible-growth and strategic-partnership opportunities.

potential_impact: Lower execution friction around government, regulatory and stakeholder dependencies in complex projects and markets.
Stronger connection between sustainability commitments, operating evidence and executive accountability.
More consistent cross-functional response to high-priority external issues, approvals and reputation-sensitive matters.
Additional country-facing leadership capacity for international growth, transformation and strategic partnerships.
background_relevance: Director-level leadership in a multinational, capital-intensive mining environment with responsibility across ESG, government relations, corporate affairs and social performance.
Daily coordination across operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and executive leadership on external commitments and regulatory matters.
Energy-transition exposure through stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Experience building evidence trails, executive briefs and accountable action frameworks for regulators, public institutions and senior management.
